## Summary

What changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] New host region
- [ ] Scanner improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI change

## Tests

- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] The four example gates generate without errors
- [ ] Lua syntax check passes (`luac -p`)
- [ ] Tested in game (say which region and mode)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one topic.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour, or the change is documentation only.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if the change is user-visible.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] No game assets, private mod content, personal paths, or private GUID bands are included.
- [ ] Generated output is not committed; the config or fixture is.
